body.name: Two-wave finite-range Palm exposure class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{2,\mathrm{loc}}:=\{P:(U_i)_{i\in\mathbb Z}\text{ is iid};\ G\text{ is shift equivariant and radius-}r\text{ local};\ E_i\text{ and }Y_i\text{ are shift equivariant and radius-}r\text{ local};\ |Y_i(d;U,G)|\le B;\ D^{(1)}\text{ and }D^{(2)}\text{ are conditionally independent given }\mathcal F_U;\ D_i^{(w)}\mid\mathcal F_U\text{ are iid }\operatorname{Bernoulli}(p);\ \min_{a\in\{e_1,e_0\}}\pi_i(a)\ge\varepsilon\text{ for every }i\in\mathbb Z\}\).
